scope: Betfair facts the betangel_research.betfair code depends on (spec section 18). Values are short paraphrases, at most one sentence each. official_* means the owner's own documentation of the thing described: Betfair's pages for the exchange (Betfair is the exchange operator), Apple's man pages for macOS tools (F68, F73, F74) and Python's own docs for its standard library (F69); vendor_* means Bet Angel only. first_person_observation is reserved for our own first-live-test receipts (T0-T10; T11 was dropped with live replace in v1), cited as a live-test:T<n>:sha256:<receipt_sha256> source that a committed reports/betfair-live-tests-<date>.json lists; after the 2026-10-13 delayed-key tests F01, F02, F03, F50, F51, F65 and F66 carry it as secondary_evidence_type. secondary_evidence_type labels a second, weaker source behind part of a value, or is null. retrieval is one label, or a list of labels in the order of the value's parts when the parts were obtained differently (F74: a man page, then a local check); every fact citing a local: source lists local_python_check.
limitations: Only delayed-key first-live tests T1, T4, T6, T7 and part of T8 ran (2026-10-13, reports/betfair-live-tests-2026-10-13.json); T0, T2, T3, T5, T9 and T10 are pending (T11 was dropped with live replace in v1) and no order has been placed.
support.betfair.com charges and T&C pages returned HTTP 403; those facts come from Wayback snapshots, and F61 also reads the live charges page through reader_proxy_read.
Paraphrases are not quotations; read the cited page before relying on a value.

facts.value: Certificate login is POST https://identitysso-cert.<tld>/api/certlogin with the client certificate presented in the TLS connection; tld is com, com.au (Australian and New Zealand customers), it, es or ro.
facts.code_handling: constant (SSO_CERT_HOSTS, SSO_PATHS)

facts.value: certlogin takes a form-urlencoded username and password body; X-Application is sent but its value is not validated.
facts.code_handling: constant

facts.value: certlogin answers {sessionToken, loginStatus}; a failure carries loginStatus only. Dropping the sample's curl -k (keeping certificate verification on) is our own advice.
facts.code_handling: parser; verification stays on

facts.value: certlogin documents 45 loginStatus values and the list may grow.
facts.code_handling: any unknown status is a failure

facts.value: Certificate login needs a 2048-bit RSA self-signed client certificate made with the documented openssl steps and uploaded by hand on the website.
facts.code_handling: docs only

facts.value: Interactive login is POST https://identitysso.<tld>/api/login with mandatory Accept: application/json; the response is {token, product, status, error}; LIMITED_ACCESS still returns a token; exceptional codes are listed outside FAIL.
facts.code_handling: can_bet=False for LIMITED_ACCESS; match exceptional codes on error

facts.value: keepAlive and logout live at <sso>/api/keepAlive and <sso>/api/logout with Accept: application/json, X-Authentication and X-Application, and answer {token, product, status, error}.
facts.code_handling: constant

facts.value: The HTTP method for keepAlive and logout: the page says POST but its curl sample sends GET.
facts.code_handling: config session.sso_http_method (default POST); first-live-test T2

facts.value: Sessions last 24 h for UK/IE customers and 12 h for other .com customers, 20 min on IT/ES; API calls do not extend a session; Logout Preferences can change it.
facts.code_handling: keepAlive bounds per jurisdiction; NO_SESSION halves the interval

facts.value: More than 100 successful logins per minute blocks new logins for 20 minutes with TEMPORARY_BAN_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS; existing sessions stay valid. Whether failed logins count is unclear.
facts.code_handling: local login caps and a persisted ban (spec section 6)

facts.value: Betting and Accounts JSON-RPC endpoints are https://api.betfair.com/exchange/betting/json-rpc/v1 and /exchange/account/json-rpc/v1 with methods SportsAPING/v1.0/<op> and AccountAPING/v1.0/<op>, POST, and X-Application, X-Authentication and Accept: application/json headers.
facts.code_handling: constant (paths, method prefixes, READ_METHODS)

facts.value: New Zealand customers use api.betfair.com.au; Italian and Spanish accounts use api.betfair.com.
facts.code_handling: api_host allowlist; api.betfair.com.au only with jurisdiction com.au (the AUS/NZ SSO hosts)

facts.value: One session token can be shared across calls; request gzip and keep-alive; idle connections close after 3 minutes; do not send Expect: 100-Continue.
facts.code_handling: idle_reconnect_s=170; no Expect header

facts.value: JSON-RPC errors carry error.data.exceptionname naming an APINGException with errorCode; code -32099 carries ANGX-00nn in the message.
facts.code_handling: spec section 7 precedence; first-live-test T4

facts.value: APINGException codes, JSON-RPC codes -32700/-32601/-32602/-32603 and DSC transport fault codes.
facts.code_handling: (surface, code) taxonomy

facts.value: Market data request weights and the 200-point per-request rule (TOO_MUCH_DATA above it).
facts.code_handling: weight planner with conservative depth multiplier

facts.value: Call listMarketBook at most 5 times per second per market (guidance); request OPEN and CLOSED markets separately; at most 250 betIds/marketIds.
facts.code_handling: throttle 4/s per market; single-id re-request of missing ids

facts.value: listMarketBook with order or match projections, listCurrentOrders and listMarketProfitAndLoss share a 3-request concurrency limit per account; the two sources disagree on whether listClearedOrders shares it and on whether queued or executing requests count.
facts.code_handling: local in-flight cap 2

facts.value: More than 1000 instructions per second gives TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.
facts.code_handling: local caps far below

facts.value: Per-request instruction limits: place 200 (50 on the Italian exchange); cancel, replace and update 60; exceeding them gives INVALID_INPUT_DATA.
facts.code_handling: V7; cancel requests hold at most 60 bet ids

facts.value: customerRef is at most 32 characters from letters, digits and : - . _ + * ; ~ and de-duplicates resubmissions within 60 s.
facts.code_handling: unique per request and never reused

facts.value: Whether customerRef is echoed in the execution report.
facts.code_handling: not relied on; first-live-test T9 observes it

facts.value: customerOrderRef is at most 32 characters, is not checked for uniqueness and can be filtered on; its character set is not stated.
facts.code_handling: charset [A-Za-z0-9-]; local unique index; A19 via live-probe

facts.value: customerStrategyRef is at most 15 characters.
facts.code_handling: pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,15}$

facts.value: marketVersion lapses an order as FAILURE / BET_ACTION_ERROR / BET_TAKEN_OR_LAPSED with a betId echoed, but Betfair's pages disagree whether any higher version or only a material (under-suspension) change triggers it.
facts.code_handling: spec section 9.4 rule 2: UNKNOWN until confirmed

facts.value: MarketBook.version monotonicity: MarketBook says it increments, the MarketVersion type says non-monotonic.
facts.code_handling: no monotonic assumption

facts.value: placeOrders is atomic unless Best Execution is off, in which case PROCESSED_WITH_ERRORS can occur.
facts.code_handling: classify per instruction

facts.value: Order calls time out after 5 s (TIMEOUT); allow 15 s for the order to appear before treating it as lapsed.
facts.code_handling: reconcile window, grace and 3 successful polls; the kill's re-sweep bound (ORDER_TIMEOUT_S + ORDER_VISIBILITY_S + IN_PLAY_DELAY_MAX_S + 3 s = 35 s after the KILL file)

facts.value: ExecutionReportStatus, InstructionReportStatus, error code enums, OrderStatus, PersistenceType and Side values.
facts.code_handling: (surface, code) tables; enum constants

facts.value: BET_IN_PROGRESS is an instruction error code (no matcher result within a system timeout) and TIMEOUT a report status (bet status unknown; check listCurrentOrders; unprocessed bets are lapsed once a 15 s window passes), but how they differ in practice is undocumented.
facts.code_handling: treated as UNKNOWN

facts.value: cancelOrders with no marketId and no instructions cancels every bet on the account; a concurrent cancel-all is rejected or gives ERROR_IN_MATCHER; it applies to LIMIT bets only.
facts.code_handling: own-scope kill by default; account-wide kill gated; a rejected concurrent cancel-all ends the kill kill_incomplete (exit 3)

facts.value: replaceOrders is a cancel followed by an atomic place with no rollback; CANCELLED_NOT_PLACED exists; the new betId is in placeInstructionReport.
facts.code_handling: paper only: REPLACED with a linked child, provisional child counted adversarially; live replace removed in v1; T11 dropped

facts.value: Whether the replacement bet inherits customerOrderRef and customerStrategyRef.
facts.code_handling: paper only (provisional child); live replace removed in v1, so no live code depends on it; T11 dropped

facts.value: listCurrentOrders takes betIds/marketIds (250 combined), includeSourceId and dateRange (not the legacy placedDateRange); pages hold 1000 with moreAvailable; BY_BET ordering is deprecated.
facts.code_handling: BY_PLACE_TIME with dateRange

facts.value: listClearedOrders needs betStatus; groupBy applies only to SETTLED (BET needed for LAPSED/CANCELLED); the default window is 90 days and a from date is advised.
facts.code_handling: settled_from_utc required by us; groupBy only for SETTLED

facts.value: Lapsed and cancelled bets are not documented as appearing in listClearedOrders before the market settles, and forum replies (including Betfair Developer Program staff, 2014-2015) say they appear only after settlement.
facts.code_handling: not sufficient on its own for ABSENT_UNCONFIRMED; in live, cleared rows only establish that a bet exists (EXECUTABLE at worst case, never a terminal state); first-live-test T10

facts.value: ClearedOrderSummary documents profit; its commission field names an EXCHANGE grouping that the GroupBy enum (EVENT_TYPE, EVENT, MARKET, SIDE, BET) does not offer. The sign and basis of profit and the use of priceMatched/sizeSettled are unverified.
facts.code_handling: live P&L informational: no code path writes settled profit from cleared rows; settle-market books each order's worst case; orders-cleared shows Betfair's figure

facts.value: GBP minimum bet £1, minimum BSP liability £10, minimum bet payout £10.
facts.code_handling: V5 (at least £1 only)

facts.value: INVALID_PROFIT_RATIO refuses bets whose penny-rounded winnings are 20% less or 25% more than they ought to be; rounding to the nearest penny or cent is documented, the tie-break and exact boundaries are not.
facts.code_handling: V14 checks both half-up and half-even rounding

facts.value: Bet sizes have 2 decimal places of precision.
facts.code_handling: exact 2 dp required

facts.value: CLASSIC ladder (350 ticks 1.01-1000), FINEST and LINE_RANGE ladders; catalogue priceLadderDescription.type; the stream's priceLadderDefinition is an object in the Swagger but a string in the doc table.
facts.code_handling: CLASSIC only; book.ladder_type() accepts both shapes

facts.value: In-play bets carry a 1-12 s delay; PASSIVE/DYNAMIC delay types; KEEP persistence is invalid on PASSIVE markets.
facts.code_handling: in-play refused in v1; LAPSE only; IN_PLAY_DELAY_MAX_S = 12 is part of the kill's re-sweep bound

facts.value: MarketBook gating fields include isMarketDataDelayed and runner statuses; REST MarketBook has no bettingType, marketType, eventTypeId, ladder type or marketTime.
facts.code_handling: catalogue join; V9, V10 and A18

facts.value: The delayed key places real bets (key table); there is no sandbox; delayed data is 1-180 s late with 3 levels and no runner totalMatched; the stream allows 2 connections and 200 markets and is conflated to 180000 ms.
facts.code_handling: arming independent of key; labels; the gateway refuses delayed-key orders

facts.value: PERMISSION_DENIED wording about the delayed key differs between the enum page and the support article.
facts.code_handling: terminal_account; never probed (v1 never orders on the delayed key)

facts.value: The live key costs a one-off, non-refundable £499; it needs a KYC-verified, funded account; read-only use of the live key is not permitted.
facts.code_handling: recorder.allow_live_key=false by default

facts.value: An unfunded or overridden live key returns delayed data.
facts.code_handling: A18 requires is_market_data_delayed False

facts.value: The stream is a TLS socket of CRLF-delimited JSON at stream-api.betfair.com:443; the first message must be sent within 15 s; connection, authentication and status message fields; ladderLevels 1-10 in the Swagger.
facts.code_handling: constants (STREAM_HOSTS, STREAM_PORT, timeouts)

facts.value: Stream error codes; every error except SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED closes the connection (INVALID_REQUEST appears in the Swagger only).
facts.code_handling: stream_status error surface

facts.value: heartbeatMs may be requested as 500-5000 and the echo is the interval actually used, which only the Swagger bounds as 500-30000; the interval defaults to 5000 ms and a heartbeat line carries clk and is sent only when nothing else was sent in it.
facts.code_handling: use the echoed value; conflation-aware liveness; first-live-test T6

facts.value: conflateMs may be requested as 0-120000 (Swagger only); the delayed key, or a live key with an account delay, gets 180000; the default of 0 is inferred from examples only.
facts.code_handling: null default; record the echoed value

facts.value: Segmentation is size-based (about 1000+ markets, mostly initial images) and the Swagger says segmentationEnabled allows it; whether false or omitting the flag reliably prevents segments is unverified.
facts.code_handling: close the segment if a segmented line is seen

facts.value: clk and initialClk support resubscription (RESUB_DELTA) and INVALID_CLOCK exists; pt ordering is guaranteed.
facts.code_handling: fresh image per segment; never resume with clocks

facts.value: ChangeMessage, MarketChange and RunnerChange fields; deletion semantics; GBP sizes; Infinity sizes; settlement zeroing; duplicate markets keep the higher version.
facts.code_handling: cache rules in book.py

facts.value: The default subscription limit is 200 markets; closed markets are evicted about 1 h 5 min after close.
facts.code_handling: pre-count; max_markets 150 (ceiling 180); stop on SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED

facts.value: The live-key stream connection limit is not published.
facts.code_handling: read connectionsAvailable at authentication

facts.value: The order stream's initial image lists only executable (unmatched) orders; whether runner-removal voids and lapses appear on the order stream conflicts between the Stream API doc (yes, since 2017-04-04) and a support article (no).
facts.code_handling: v1 reconciles through REST only

facts.value: The Heartbeat API cancels all LIMIT bets for the customer on the exchange (not per app key) when heartbeats stop; the timeout is 10-300 s; it can unregister silently.
facts.code_handling: A9 refuses heartbeat_api_enabled; the path is not in the transport allowlist

facts.value: Historical data uses the stream format; the ADV package carries batb/batl, trd, tv and ltp at 1 s.
facts.code_handling: ADV-like recorder fields by default

facts.value: PRO historical data counts traded volume as backer's stake x 2, and Betfair says API totalMatched uses a different calculation from that x2 basis (for example it excludes self-matched volume); the live traded-ladder basis is unverified.
facts.code_handling: traded_volume_divisor 2, labelled; first-live-test T8

facts.value: Transaction charges apply only above 5000 qualifying transactions in a clock hour (placed bets plus failed transactions; a successful cancel adds none, a failed cancel adds one), priced per type on the live charges page, which supersedes the flat 0.2p of the July 2025 archive.
facts.code_handling: count only; max_transactions_per_hour 300 (ceiling 1000)

facts.value: UK commission follows the My Betfair Rewards package and Basic 2% is Betfair's own example; the 5% and 8% rates (and so the example config's 5%) come only from a secondary source, not from Betfair.
facts.code_handling: commission_rate and commission_source are required config

facts.value: Terms and conditions: the API is a betting channel (18.3, 12.1.4); data is for personal non-commercial use (19.3); one account per person (6.1); cancellation is effective on confirmation (18.12). The live page returned 403.
facts.code_handling: docs; licence note in recorder receipts

facts.value: API access from geo-restricted IP regions (MaxMind), including the US, DE, NL, FR and SG, is blocked.
facts.code_handling: A10 operator egress attestation and cloud markers

facts.value: getAccountFunds returns availableToBetBalance, exposure, retainedCommission, exposureLimit, discountRate and pointsBalance; exposureLimit was negative in our delayed-key T7 run, and the sign of a non-zero exposure is unverified.
facts.code_handling: abs(exposure); first-live-test T7

facts.value: AccountDetails includes currencyCode.
facts.code_handling: A16 (an absent value fails)

facts.value: A new login does not invalidate other sessions, so Bet Angel and the website can coexist with our session.
facts.code_handling: --bet-angel-paused required until first-live-test T3; the kill logs in a separate emergency session and prints the F67 warning while coexistence is unverified

facts.value: security add-generic-password with -w as the last option prompts for the value; find-generic-password -w prints only the password.
facts.code_handling: exit codes not relied on, except that anchor_read treats exit 44 (errSecItemNotFound) from both lookups as 'no anchor' and fails closed on any other result; exit 44 is inferred from the OSStatus, not in the man page (unverified); first-live-test T0

facts.value: ssl.SSLContext.load_cert_chain(certfile, keyfile, password) loads the client certificate and urllib.parse.urlencode returns str that needs .encode() before sending; documented in the Python 3.14 docs and checked locally on Python 3.14.6 with synthetic files, never against Betfair.
facts.code_handling: as specified; make_tls_context never lets OpenSSL prompt for a passphrase

facts.value: RANK is not a MarketSort member; listMarketCatalogue maxResults is at most 1000; CLOSED markets are not returned by the catalogue.
facts.code_handling: never send sort RANK; cache catalogue rows

facts.value: listCurrentOrders and listClearedOrders accept includeSourceId; sourceIdKey is the app key used to place the order; its value format is unverified.
facts.code_handling: startup reconcile and reconcile_unknown leg (it only halts); no longer a kill leg since the v1 narrowing; stripped from storage

facts.value: The filter parameter of listEventTypes and listMarketCatalogue is required.
facts.code_handling: always send {} or refuse None

facts.value: security add-generic-password -T "" removes the default no-warning access of the creating application (man page); whether every later read then prompts is unverified.
facts.code_handling: printed by keychain-setup; first-live-test T0

facts.value: macOS fsync does not flush the drive cache and F_FULLFSYNC does (man page); SQLite's PRAGMA fullfsync was checked locally on SQLite 3.53.2.
facts.code_handling: receipts.full_fsync and the journal pragmas; the SQLite part is a local check (secondary inferred, local_python_check), not documentation

facts.value: REST MarketFilter keys (marketCountries, marketTypeCodes, marketStartTime) differ from stream keys (countryCodes, marketTypes, no time range).
facts.code_handling: filters.py mapping

facts.value: One person may hold one account (T&C 6.1); a second local profile for the same account would split the caps.
facts.code_handling: accounts.json registry (A15)

facts.value: After a market closes, listMarketBook returns it as CLOSED for an unverified period, and listCurrentOrders stops listing a bet once its market is settled.
facts.code_handling: settle-market P2 (CLOSED on listMarketBook) and P3 (none of our bets current); if Betfair keeps listing them settle-market refuses; a market no longer returned cannot be settled in v1 and stays counted at worst case (A20, decided by Yu 2026-10-11: kept; settle soon after close); first-live-test T10 extended
